meta_description: JMD Decorators is a painter and decorator serving Leeds and Bradford. Interior and exterior work, free quotes, fully insured. Call today.
hero_subhead: Professional painting and decorating that transforms your home. Free quotes, no obligation, reliable service every time.
services_heading: Decorating Services Across Leeds and Bradford
services_subhead: From interior refreshes to exterior transformations, we handle every aspect of residential and commercial decorating with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Decorating
services.desc: Complete interior redecorating including walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls. We prepare surfaces properly so your new finish lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior work including fascias, soffits, windows, and doors. Weather-resistant finishes protect your home for years.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Add personality to any room with carefully chosen feature walls and bold accent colours. We help you choose shades that work with your space.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery
services.desc: Professional painting and staining of doors, skirting boards, staircases, and built-in joinery. Expert preparation ensures a flawless finish.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Office refurbishment and commercial interior work completed to schedule, with minimal disruption to your business.

services.title: Preparation & Problem Solving
services.desc: We don't cut corners on prep work. Damp issues, cracked plaster, and old finishes are tackled properly before painting begins.

about_pullquote: I started decorating because I wanted to do it right — properly prepared, no shortcuts, fair price.
about_para_1: JMD Decorators has been transforming homes and businesses across Leeds and Bradford for over a decade. We specialise in interior and exterior painting, from small single-room refreshes to complete house renovations. Every job starts with honest preparation and finishes with a result you'll be proud of.
about_para_2: We're fully insured, reliable, and we stand behind our work. Our customers return to us time and again because we listen, we communicate, and we deliver on our promises. No high-pressure sales, no hidden costs — just straightforward, professional decorating.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About JMD Decorators

reviews.text: Had my lounge and hallway redecorated by JMD. The whole place looks completely different. They were tidy, professional, and finished on time. Fair price too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our exterior. The woodwork needed a lot of prep work and they didn't skip it. Paint's holding up really well through the winter. Very pleased.
reviews.author: Susan H.

reviews.text: Can't fault JMD. Did a feature wall in our bedroom and the finish is perfect. Clear communication from start to finish, friendly lads, and left the place spotless. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: David P.
